title.zh: 将奎松省奎松市镇的马斯卡里纳村立学校与比利亚戈麦斯村立学校的名称分别变更为佩德罗卡班贡村立学校与乌尔皮亚诺卡马乔村立学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Names of Mascarina Barrio School and Villa Gomez Barrio School in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Quezon, to Pedro Cabangon Barrio School and Ulpiano Camacho Barrio School, Respectively
title.orig: An Act Changing the Names of Mascarina Barrio School and Villa Gomez Barrio School in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Quezon, to Pedro Cabangon Barrio School and Ulpiano Camacho Barrio School, Respectively

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4253_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The names of Mascarina Barrio School and Villa Gomez Barrio School in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Quezon, are hereby changed to Pedro Cabangon Barrio School and Ulpiano Camacho Barrio School, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
